messages.subject: mirtCAT reverse-code likert scale
parts:
I have a survey with a 4-point likert scale that I want to administer on mirtCAT. Items are rated Never Sometimes Often or Always. Sometimes Never=0 and Always=3 and sometimes Never=3 and Always=0. I want the radio buttons to always go Never to Always left-to-right. How can I reverse-code the scored responses? I've tried editing the Answer.# in df or the shinyGUI choiceValues arguments, but neither worked. Is there a way to do this or must I have some items going Always-to-Never?

Thanks,
Aaron

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirtCAT reverse-code likert scale
parts:
Good question. In mirtCAT I assume that the data will be collected in a form that would have been passed directly to mirt(). So in your case, what you would see in the IRT estimates is that the slope parameter (the a's) will be in the negative direction without reversing the score ordering. To account for this in your CAT application then, just initialise the item parameters that are collected with a reverse scoring format with the negative of the slope parameter instead. So if your GRM had the parameters [a1=1.2, d1=4, d2=0, d3=-1], then just use [a1= -1*1.2, d1=4, d2=0, d3=-1] instead. HTH.

Phil

Item selection differs, but final estimates are w/i the SE, so its not a problem... just an observation. Thanks for all your help, Phil.
